Mission Path

IN PROGRESS

    DEEP SEA VISION

    You are the onboard AI of an underwater vehicle. Read the sensors, make the call, and keep the mission alive.

    A project by Julien DubucTimm ClaverieThéo CoulongeatJules LaurentThomas Koch-Legrand

    HOW TO PLAY

    • You play the Artificial Intelligence controlling an underwater vehicle (an AUV). It sees the world only through its sensors: cameras, sonar, and magnetic detectors.
    • Pick a vehicle, read what its sensors are telling you, and choose what the AI should do next.
    • Some mistakes can be rescued: a bonus question offers an emergency override, and a correct answer keeps the mission alive. A wrong override, or a fatal mistake, is a true Game Over.
    • The progress bar and the path tracker show how far you are into the mission. Watch for mini-games: type commands, tune filters, classify sensor signatures, or sneak past radar sweeps. A small timer runs during the mission: finish it to get your time and compare it with other players.
    • Tap an underlined word for a quick definition. After a correct answer you get a short explanation. At the end you earn up to 3 stars and a result card to share.

    CHOOSE YOUR VESSEL
